panel.title: Research
panel.intro: Find recommended destinations and options for this trip. The research runs in the background and can take up to a minute and a half.
panel.locked: Complete the brief before starting research.
panel.queued_help: Your research run is waiting to be picked up.
panel.running_help: This can take up to a minute and a half. You can leave this page and come back — it keeps running.
panel.ready_help: Research finished for this trip. Review the options below and choose one to plan.
panel.in_progress_generic: Research is in progress for this trip.

results.title: Recommended destinations
results.empty_help: We could not find a destination that fits this brief with enough confidence. Adjust the brief and run research again.
results.selected_help: This destination is confirmed for your trip. Itinerary planning unlocks next.
results.select_failed: That destination could not be selected. Please try again.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Research and selection need a connection. You can still read what is already on this page.

error.title: Research could not be completed
error.research_timeout: The research run took too long and was stopped. You can try again.
error.research_failed: The research run failed. You can try again.
error.research_interrupted: The research run was interrupted. You can try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong during research. You can try again.
error.start_failed: Research could not be started. Please try again.
